WITH src AS (SELECT id FROM sources WHERE id = $1::uuid AND user_id = $2),
  used AS (SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM career_evidence WHERE user_id = $2 AND provenance->>'sourceId' = $1::uuid::text),
  unpinned AS (UPDATE profiles SET resume_source_id = NULL FROM src, used
    WHERE profiles.user_id = $2 AND profiles.resume_source_id = src.id AND used.n = 0),
  gone AS (DELETE FROM sources USING used WHERE sources.id = $1::uuid AND sources.user_id = $2 AND used.n = 0 RETURNING sources.id)
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM src)::int AS found, (SELECT n FROM used) AS used, (SELECT count(*) FROM gone)::int AS deleted

WITH ins_job AS (
  INSERT INTO ai_jobs (
    id, type, queue, user_id, company_id, plan, status, attempts, max_attempts,
    payload, idempotency_key, conversation_id
  ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'QUEUED', 0, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10)
  RETURNING id, queue
), ins_out AS (
  INSERT INTO outbox (job_id, queue)
  SELECT id, queue FROM ins_job
  RETURNING job_id
)
SELECT ins_job.id, ins_job.queue FROM ins_job
JOIN ins_out ON ins_out.job_id = ins_job.id

SELECT u.id, u.display_name, u.locale, u.plan, u.subscription_status, u.stripe_customer_id, u.period_ends_at, u.created_at, u.is_employer, u.email, u.provider, (SELECT company_id FROM company_members WHERE company_members.user_id = u.id) AS company_id, (SELECT role FROM company_members WHERE company_members.user_id = u.id) AS company_role, t.expires_at AS token_expires_at FROM access_tokens t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.token_hash = $1

INSERT INTO rate_limits (bucket, hits, expires_at) VALUES ($1, 1, to_timestamp($2::double precision)) ON CONFLICT (bucket) DO UPDATE SET hits = rate_limits.hits + 1 WHERE rate_limits.hits < $3 RETURNING hits

SELECT id, user_id, revision, kind, title, source_text, source_url, skills, verification_status, provenance, supersedes_id, archived, created_at, updated_at FROM career_evidence WHERE user_id = $1 AND NOT archived ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT u.id, u.display_name, u.locale, u.plan, u.subscription_status, u.stripe_customer_id, u.period_ends_at, u.created_at, u.is_employer, u.email, u.provider, (SELECT company_id FROM company_members WHERE company_members.user_id = u.id) AS company_id, (SELECT role FROM company_members WHERE company_members.user_id = u.id) AS company_role, t.expires_at AS token_expires_at FROM access_tokens t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.token_hash = $1

INSERT INTO rate_limits (bucket, hits, expires_at) VALUES ($1, 1, to_timestamp($2::double precision)) ON CONFLICT (bucket) DO UPDATE SET hits = rate_limits.hits + 1 WHERE rate_limits.hits < $3 RETURNING hits
SELECT id, file_name, mime_type, size, page_count, origin, created_at, to_jsonb(sources)->>'doc_kind' AS doc_kind FROM sources WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.created_at, to_jsonb(d)->>'kind' AS kind, a.company, a.title AS posting_title FROM documents d LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.id = d.application_id WHERE d.user_id = $1 AND d.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT $2
